change.title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
change.goal: Find eligible teaching material for the actual learning problem.
change.rationale: Topic similarity alone does not establish teaching suitability or permission to reuse content.
change.scope: Initial unimplemented draft. Reviewed homework/speaking activities, explanations, reading/listening input, vocabulary/fluency/discourse/strategy activities and task/project frameworks under PD-40. Application-owned search construction from selected objectives, controlled embedding text, separate authorization/eligibility filters and explicit candidate/gap/failure outcomes. Direct private evidence loading and metrics stay separate. Sources: PD-13/15/16/28/33 and Architecture section 6. LLM query rewriting, autonomous search loops and ranking/index tuning are deferred.

depends_on.reason: Uses the authenticated tutor and learner-evidence ownership boundary.

requirement.title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
requirement.statement: Retrieve permissioned, reviewed material by selected teaching purpose/outcome, applicable skills/optional exact confusion, modality, accessibility/support and task demands, with source/version references. Apply access and license restrictions before ranking; never turn private transcripts into shared teaching assets or invent missing exercise references. The application constructs a controlled teaching-search description and separate filters from a selected structured objective, calls the embedding model and executes the authorized database search. Initial search construction uses no chat-model rewriting or autonomous search loop; model suggestions cannot supply authorization or relax hard constraints. Learner-record loading and metric calculation are separate operations. Remediation needs its actual confusion; a goal-led route needs no invented error. Listening requires available permitted recording/version references and reviewer-checked matching answers/criteria; a transcript alone is insufficient. All routes preserve reviewed-source/adaptation limits.

scenarios.given: Eligible reviewed material matches the target confusion and level.
scenarios.then: Candidates include suitable material and its source/version, rather than merely a preferred-topic match.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval observation against a small reviewed fixture bank.

scenarios.given: The only apparent matches are unauthorized, unreviewed or unavailable.
scenarios.then: Those items are not returned as eligible; the content gap remains explicit.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval eligibility and no-match cases.

scenarios.given: A selected contrastive-choice objective has level/task/domain constraints and evidence references; private learner text and untrusted model-supplied scope are also present in the surrounding context.
scenarios.when: The worker constructs and executes its teaching-material search.
scenarios.then: Application code builds a non-sensitive description preserving the teaching distinction and separate validated filters; authenticated server context owns scope. Private learner text stays out of the embedding input, and initial query construction makes no chat-model call. Return eligible asset IDs/versions and provenance for suitability checks; topic similarity cannot override hard constraints. Invalid search fields are rejected before provider use.
scenarios.verification: Future search-construction and actual provider/database-boundary checks with fixed objectives, private canaries, scope manipulation, malformed fields and call counts.

scenarios.given: The embedding provider or database fails during an otherwise valid material search.
scenarios.when: The worker handles the retrieval outcome.
scenarios.then: Report a preparation failure rather than an empty-bank/content-gap result; no invented vector, candidate reference or ready material is produced.
scenarios.verification: Future injected provider/database failures contrasted with a successful search returning no eligible candidates.

scenarios.given: A supported reading/listening, vocabulary, fluency, discourse, strategy or task/project goal has eligible reviewed material but no recent error.
scenarios.when: The application constructs and executes the selected route search.
scenarios.then: Preserve purpose/outcome, relevant skills, modality/demands/support/criteria and hard filters without fabricating a confusion. Return suitable reviewed input/activity/framework versions; domain-only or inaccessible matches are unsuitable.
scenarios.verification: Future controlled search/provider/database cases for each enabled route, including no-confusion objectives and wrong-purpose distractors.

scenarios.given: A listening candidate is known unavailable/unpermitted or its reviewed key/criteria do not match the recording version.
scenarios.when: The material is checked for selection/adaptation.
scenarios.then: Do not retain it as suitable listening material; use checked eligible material or disclose a gap. Neither a text transcript nor an assignment establishes listening performance. Transient provider/database failures remain failures under S4.
scenarios.verification: Future recording-reference eligibility, version/key-correspondence and explicit gap cases distinct from provider failures.
